text.join|p:div:nth-of-type(1)>div:nth-of-typ: Any time. Teams are busiest during their competition season, but new members are taken all year.
Membership is a $50 club fee for the year, and it covers all five teams. Materials and entry fees are covered by sponsorship and fundraising. Ask a faculty sponsor if cost is a concern.

No experience required and no application to write. You join STEMWorks as a whole — one $50 club fee gives you access to all five teams, so fill out the interest form, come to a meeting in Room 140A, and work on whichever builds interest you.
